title: Subject:
prompt:
Subject:
Pink wheels on a night road

Subject:
A full-body portrait of a young woman in white and pink sportswear standing on roller skates on a paved path in a park at night. The foreground white skate and pink wheels at the bottom right are extremely enlarged, looking up at the person from a low angle.

Character/Expression:
A small oval face tilted slightly to the left, looking down at the camera with dark brown eyes. Thin eyebrows and light coral lips with a calm expression. Light brown hair down to the shoulders with soft bangs and gentle waves, flowing over the left shoulder.

Costume/Pose:
A white cropped T-shirt and dusty pink shorts. The shirt has a crew neck and two pink lines on the sleeve edges. The shorts feature white piping, a white drawstring on the left waist, and a high-cut hem. White knee-high socks with two pink lines at the top. White high-top roller skates with pink laces, four pink wheels, and light brown soles. Right hand on the hip, left arm behind the back, with one leg stepping forward toward the camera.

Background/Lighting:
The foreground is grey cobblestone. The background consists of a black night sky, dark green trees, metal fences, and several white streetlights. Hard white light from streetlights on the left and back-right illuminates the face, clothes, thighs, and shoes, casting long shadows on the pavement.

Composition/Camera:
3:4 vertical aspect ratio. A wide-angle shot from a very low angle near the ground, capturing the full body from the top of the head to both skates. The foreground right skate is placed prominently in the bottom third of the frame, the left skate in the center-bottom, and the face toward the top-left. Focus is sharp on the shoes and the person, while the background park lights are lightly blurred.

Texture/Style:
A high-definition photorealistic night scene featuring a palette of black, white, dusty pink, and warm streetlight white. Precisely renders leather textures, laces, resin wheels, ribbed socks, paving stones, and harsh night lighting.

Negative:
Do not diminish the size of the large foreground skate or the intensity of the low-angle perspective.
